Senses.Explanation: A bottomless bowl lacks what an ordinary vessel needs to hold food, yet Chan records make it receive and transmit. Masters call it something transmitted by a thousand sages, ask who inherits it, and still fill it with rice and soup; elsewhere it appears as a radiant answer or an object wrested from a predecessor.
